topic: find analyzer must reject path-qualified executables
lesson: readOnlyMetaExecutor may only be true for the bare command word find (no path component, no ./find, /tmp/find, or any basename match) — autoreview r2 P1: the analyzer accepted any executable whose basename is find, letting an untrusted path-qualified binary be relaxed. Reject path-qualified or otherwise qualified executables before any option parsing; add the case to the parameterized safety test.
